title: Bikie ‘not surprised’ if he used fake $20,000 souvlaki invoice to pocket thousands on Big Build site, inquiry hears
description:
Royal commission sees text message where Bandidos member Joel Leavitt says ‘just make up a quote that hits 20K’ while working on site for CFMEU

A Bandidos gang member says it is possible he used a fake $20,000 invoice for souvlaki to pocket thousands of dollars while employed on a Big Build site.

Former CFMEU member and bikie, Joel Leavitt faced a second day of examination by the royal commission into alleged corruption across Victoria’s construction sector on Wednesday.
